channel.title: Paint & Coatings Industry Magazine - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from Paint & Coatings Industry Magazine (pcimag.com)

item.title: ACD Responds to Supreme Court Tariff Decision
item.description: The association issued an industry-focused response addressing implications for used drum management and regulatory oversight.

item.title: ChemQuest Marks 50 Years in Specialty Chemicals Consulting
item.description: The firm reflects on five decades supporting formulated products, specialty chemicals and materials-driven markets.

item.title: Covestro CEO Will Not Extend Contract Beyond 2028
item.description: The company said its supervisory board will begin a succession process as the current chief executive prepares for a planned transition.

item.title: Gehring Montgomery Achieves Consecutive EcoVadis Platinum Ratings
item.description: Gehring Montgomery announced it secured EcoVadis Platinum status for 2025 and 2026, placing it among the highest-performing companies assessed worldwide.

item.title: AMPP Backs U.S. Maritime Strategy with Corrosion Focus
item.description: AMPP endorsed America’s Maritime Action Plan, underscoring how protective coatings, corrosion control, and standards shape fleet readiness and lifecycle performance.

item.title: Steelpaint Applies Corrosion System on Xiamen Min Hua Newbuild
item.description: The company completed coating application on a 12,000-dwt cargo vessel as the owner broadens corrosion-protection scope ahead of delivery.

item.title: Dürr Launches High-Resolution System for In-Process Vehicle Graphics
item.description: Dürr introduced an automated application platform that integrates complex graphics directly into the automotive painting process.

item.title: AkzoNobel Groups Sustainable Powder Coatings Under New Designation
item.description: The company introduced a portfolio framework highlighting powder coatings with verified sustainability and performance attributes.

item.title: CCAI Launches Leadership Program for Finishing Operations
item.description: Chemical Coaters Association International announced a new leadership training initiative aimed at workforce retention, management development, and shop-level performance.

item.title: Maintenance-Free Promise: Balancing Performance Claims with Sustainability Reporting Requirements
item.description: Sustainability reporting and EPDs are reshaping how long-term performance claims are defined, verified and communicated in architectural coatings.
